title: Cutting a regression build from 2 hours to 45 minutes
problem: The shop reservation system's Jenkins regression build took about 2 hours, and the suite produced around 40 new test cases a month. Flaky tests and CI failures slowed every release.
approach: Moved the suite to Robot Framework Browser Library (Playwright-based).
Found and fixed flaky scripts and CI execution issues.
Used Claude AI to speed up test script development and optimisation.
result: Build time down from ~2 hours to ~45 minutes (about 62% faster).
Test output up from ~40 a month to nearly 200 in two months.
A more stable CI run, with execution reports shared with stakeholders.
note: Client details are kept general to respect confidentiality.

title: Testing an AI chatbot builder with no playbook
problem: NeuraTalk lets businesses build LLM and Rasa chatbots. Chatbot answers vary in wording, so exact-match assertions do not work, and there was no existing test playbook.
approach: Designed a Python framework that compares responses using BERT semantic embeddings instead of exact text.
Covered intent recognition, entity extraction, fallback handling, context switching and multi-turn accuracy.
Extended coverage to bot creation and deployment, canvas creation, message flows and bot-to-agent handover in QA and staging.
result: Recognised as Tester of the Quarter (Q4 2025) for this work.
note: Client details are kept general to respect confidentiality.

title: Mobile regression in 5 hours instead of 3 days
problem: Regression testing for the SIDDHI CRM mobile app (React Native, Android and iOS) took about 3 days per cycle.
approach: Designed a page object model Appium framework in Java from scratch.
Onboarded the team so they could extend the framework themselves.
result: Regression cycle down from 3 days to 5 hours.
60+ bugs raised and resolved before release deadlines.
note: Delivered at Tata Consultancy Services. Client details are kept general.
